dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance; here it applies the real-number addition instance to the real operands 1 and x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the left-hand expression 1 + x as a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance; here it is the usual order relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts that the real expression 1 + x is at most the real exponential of x.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interpretation of a natural-number numeral in a type having the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the numeral 1 as the real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical OfNat instance for the numeral 1 induced by a type's distinguished one element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the numeral 1 on the left side is Real.instOne's real unit.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the quantified variable and both sides of the inequality to be real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real exponential function, implemented as the real part of the complex exponential evaluated on the complex embedding of a real input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies exp(x), the right-hand side of the inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The addition structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes HAdd.hAdd in the target ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal order structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes LE.le in the target the ordinary real inequality relation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished multiplicative identity element of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constant 1 occurring in 1 + x.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HAdd instance built from an Add instance, with hAdd equal to that instance's addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with Real.instAdd, it resolves the displayed heterogeneous addition to real addition.

binders: A universally quantified real number x.
conclusions: 1 + x is less than or equal to exp(x).
mathematical_definitions: Addition and the order relation are the ordinary operations on the real numbers.
The numeral 1 denotes the real number one.
exp(x) denotes the real exponential function evaluated at x.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every real number x, one plus x is at most the real exponential of x: 1 + x ≤ exp(x).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition is restricted to real inputs and uses the real exponential, addition, and order.
There are no hypotheses or exceptional cases, so the statement applies to every real x and has no hypothesis-based vacuity risk.
